description: Fact-extraction rules used by the Collision Sentinel. Each rule pulls one comparable fact out of the raw documents; differing normalized values across files = a conflict. Swap this file for an LLM extractor later without changing the pipeline.

rules.description: The number of hours worked (per day) after which the 150% overtime rate applies for PC 200 employees, including night-shift specifics. Value is the number of hours, e.g. 8 or 7.5.

The number of business days within which approved expense claims are reimbursed (reimbursement turnaround / SLA). Value is the number of business days, e.g. 10 or 15. Ignore submission deadlines and other day counts.

extractors.pattern: (?:reimbursed within|reimbursements? may take up to) (?P<value>\d+) business days

rules.description: The weeknight on-call allowance amount in EUR for France (standard on-call, not standby, weekend, holiday or intervention rates). Value is the amount, e.g. 45 or 55.

extractors.statement: Weeknight on-call allowance is fixed at EUR {value}.

rules.description: The deadline date until which unused public holidays / replacement days can be carried over into the next year in Belgium (general rule or PC 200; ignore rules explicitly scoped to other joint committees). Value is the date as written, e.g. 'March 31' or '2026-02-28'.

extractors.statement: Carry-over deadline is {value} per the rules engine (PC 200).

rules.description: The shift end time after which night-shift employees are eligible for a meal voucher, as the rule or instruction that applies. Value is a 24h time, e.g. 22:00 or 23:00. Ignore individual clients' own shift times.
